$comment: Tool descriptions Jarvis should load for the School Helper connected app. Jarvis serves these from the observation evidence School Helper pushes to /school/observations; School Helper does not implement them. Jarvis already has school_d2l_status and school_collector_revoke from merged PR #169 — these are additions, not replacements.

app.name: School Helper
app.description: Sid's Grade 12 coursework tracker. Reads his two D2L boards (LDSB and Durham) read-only and pushes the raw D2L evidence. It supplies facts only — it never ranks, prioritises or judges what matters, and it never submits or posts anything to D2L.

conventions.timestamps: All times on the wire are ISO 8601 UTC instants. Sid's local timezone is America/Toronto; convert before speaking dates aloud.
conventions.null_due_date: A null due date means NO DATE IS KNOWN. It does not mean there is no deadline, and it must never be reported as 'no due date' without that caveat.
conventions.refused_routes: A route with status 403 or 404 and complete:true is a fully observed refusal. It is evidence, not a failure. A refused submissions route does NOT mean the work is unsubmitted — it means permission was denied and submission state is unknown.
conventions.failures: A route with complete:false carries a body of {"collectorFailure": "..."}. This is a read failure. It is NOT an empty course and NOT 'nothing is due'.
conventions.host_failure_batch: A batch with course:null, courseIds:[] and enrollmentComplete:false means that whole board could not be read. Say so explicitly rather than reporting that board as clear.
conventions.empty_list: A 200 response with an empty JSON array is a real empty list and may be reported as 'nothing there'.
conventions.staleness: Evidence is only as fresh as the last push. Always check fetchedAt before answering a time-sensitive question, and say how old the reading is when it is more than a day.

tools.name: school_snapshot_read
tools.description: Returns the current known state of Sid's coursework, assembled from the most recent observation evidence for each course: assignments, quizzes, discussions, announcements, due dates, submission status, grades, weights and links. Use this for 'what have I got on', 'what's due this week', 'what's my mark in X'. The returned items are raw facts in D2L's own terms — decide relevance and urgency yourself; School Helper deliberately does not send priority scores.
tools.example: Sid asks 'what have I got due this week?' -> school_snapshot_read({ due_before: '2026-10-03T03:59:00.000Z', include_completed: false })

course_id.description: Restrict to one course, as the D2L org unit id (e.g. '1001'). Omit for all courses.

board.description: Restrict to one board. Omit for both.

due_before.description: Only items with a known due date at or before this ISO instant. Items with a null due date are excluded by this filter — request them separately with include_undated.

include_undated.description: Also return items whose due date is unknown (null).

include_completed.description: Include items already submitted or graded.

tools.name: school_changes_since
tools.description: Returns what changed in Sid's coursework since a given time: new assignments, changed due dates, new grades, new announcements, and items that stopped appearing. Use this for 'anything new?', 'did my mark come back?', or to open a morning catch-up. Compares successive observation batches, so a change is only reported when the underlying D2L evidence actually moved — not when a read simply failed.
tools.example: Sid asks 'anything new since yesterday?' -> school_changes_since({ since: '2026-09-25T12:00:00.000Z', kinds: ['grade', 'new_item', 'due_date'] })

since.description: ISO instant to compare against. Usually the last time you spoke to Sid about school.

kinds.description: Restrict to certain kinds of change. Omit for all.

include_read_failures.description: Include periods where a board or route could not be read. Keep this true: a gap in evidence is not the same as no change, and Sid should be told when a board went dark.

tools.name: school_request_sync
tools.description: Asks School Helper to read D2L again and push fresh evidence. Use when the stored evidence is stale and Sid is asking a time-sensitive question. IMPORTANT: this cannot be delivered while Sid's browser is closed, and there is currently no pull channel for the extension to receive it — the request is recorded and takes effect the next time School Helper checks in. Never tell Sid a sync has happened; tell him one has been requested, and say how old the current evidence is.
tools.example: Sid asks 'is that definitely up to date?' -> school_request_sync({ reason: 'Sid asked whether the Economics deadline had moved' })

reason.description: Why a fresh read is wanted. Shown to Sid in the link log.

board.description: Restrict the requested read to one board.

tools.name: school_open_item
tools.description: Opens a piece of coursework in Sid's browser at its D2L URL. Use when Sid says 'open that' or 'take me to it'. Like school_request_sync, this needs School Helper to be running and to check in — it is queued, not instant. It only ever opens a page for Sid to look at: it cannot submit, post, start a quiz attempt or mark anything as read.
tools.example: Sid says 'open the Economics essay' -> school_open_item({ item_url: 'https://durham.elearningontario.ca/d2l/lms/dropbox/user/folder_submit_files.d2l?db=55&ou=1002' })

item_url.description: The D2L URL from the evidence. Must be on ldsb.elearningontario.ca or durham.elearningontario.ca; any other host is refused.

course_id.description: Org unit id, for disambiguation in the link log.

note.description: Why it is being opened. Shown to Sid.

refusals.unsupported_action: School Helper executes only an explicit allow-list of actions. Anything outside it is refused and reported back as unsupported — it is never attempted.
refusals.never_submits: No tool here can submit an assignment, post to a discussion, start or answer a quiz, or mark anything read. That is a product rule, not a configuration setting.
refusals.no_pull_channel: school_request_sync and school_open_item currently have no delivery path: the gateway exposes no route for the extension to fetch pending requests. Treat them as queued intents and tell Sid plainly that they are pending.
